prompt:
Image 1 is the finished sheet; image 2 is its layout: 2 building outlines seen from above on flat magenta, in a 1×2 grid. Redraw only cell 1 (the transparent area). Keep cell 2 exactly as it is.

Cell 1's tower-block roof in image 1 is right in its material, parapet, vents and antenna, but it was drawn about 12% too shallow: from y=85 to y=495, while its outline in image 2 runs from y=25 to y=487 (x 449–1088). Draw the same roof again stretched to fill that outline exactly: its top edge on y=25, its bottom edge on the thick bottom edge at y=487, its left and right edges on x=449 and x=1088, with no magenta left inside it and nothing outside it. One fix besides: the lift machine room showed a door on its top and a strip of wall below it; seen straight down it is only a flat box roof about 3 × 5 m (55 × 90 px) with its own thin parapet, no door and no wall.

Top-down with no perspective, straight square edges, flat pure #FF00FF outside the outline. No text.

1. 35.1 × 25.4 m (1.4× wider than deep) — tall Soviet panel tower block, flat roof of black bitumen, 1 lift machine rooms as raised boxes, ventilation shafts and a low parapet round the edge
